output.search_notes: Method: candidate discovery from NAICS 238220 Texas directories, ENR Texas & Louisiana specialty-contractor rankings, TACCA Greater San Antonio/Austin member directories, Inven top-HVAC-Texas lists, Houston Business Journal family-owned awards, and local press; shortlist then enriched from company websites and LinkedIn company records (employee counts and founding years, as_of 2026-11-09). VERIFIED QUALIFIERS (13): Coopwood's Air Conditioning (Houston), Comfort-Air Engineering & Primo Plumbing (San Antonio), HCL Mechanical Services (Houston), Longhorn Mechanical Group (Van Alstyne), Raven Mechanical LP (Houston), Letsos Company (Houston), Venture Mechanical (Carrollton), Texas Chiller Systems (San Antonio), Victoria Air Conditioning (Victoria), United Mechanical (Dallas), Lochridge-Priest (Waco), Beyer Mechanical (Selma), Malek Inc. (Corpus Christi). EXCLUDED ON THESIS CHECKS: Dallas Mechanical Group (subsidiary of EMCOR Group); Gowan/Garrett Inc. (LinkedIn type 'Public Company', website gowaninc.com - EMCOR-linked); Prodigy Commercial HVAC (Denton - PitchBook financing status 'Private Equity-Backed' despite founder founding in 2018); Dallas Plumbing & Air Conditioning (acquired by Air Pros USA, 2022); Air Performance Service of Central Texas (San Antonio - portfolio company of Atlantic Street Capital via ACIS); AirCo/Champion/Rosenberg/Texas Ace/Comfort Experts/Airteam (predominantly residential); Frymire Home Services (now residential-focused, 51 LinkedIn profiles); DynaTen (363 LinkedIn employees, above 300); AiRCO Mechanical and Way Engineering (501-1,000+); Kahn Mechanical (23 employees, below 50); Gregory-Edwards (19) and SM Air/San Marcos AC (19) too small; Gray Mechanical Contractors (installation/construction-focused, weak service fit); CFI Mechanical and Graco Mechanical (construction-focused, unverified size bands 201-500); TD Industries (thousands of employees, employee-owned); Lochridge-Priest carried a chamber-profile claim of 400+ employees vs 200 on LinkedIn and was kept with a size flag; Beyer Mechanical (49 profiles vs 51-200 band) and Malek (56 profiles vs 201-500 band) similarly flagged rather than dropped. LAST FUNDING: no equity/funding round was found for any listed company (all privately held); the only funding-type event found was Longhorn Mechanical's forgiven 2020 PPP loan. HEADCOUNT GROWTH: two dated counts were verifiable only for Longhorn Mechanical (97 in Apr 2020 per PPP -> 110 per Form 5500 FY2025); for the others only single dated counts (company site or LinkedIn, retrieved 2026-11-09) were available and earlier counts were not found. Fields left null = value not found in any retrieved page.
